fields.description: The message this attachment belongs to. Never changes once written.
fields.label: Message

fields.description: Denormalised from the message on purpose: the download endpoint's membership check must not have to join through Chat Message.
fields.label: Room

fields.description: Mirrors Google's Attachment.source. Uploaded = a Chat-hosted blob we may copy (UPLOADED_CONTENT). Drive Link = a Drive file we may only link to (DRIVE_FILE), because copying the bytes would re-home somebody else's Drive ACL inside our permission model. ERPNext = uploaded on our side first.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Where the ingest of this attachment got to. Written by Phase 2's ingest job, which is retried by the sweeper and must therefore be idempotent.
fields.label: Ingest State

fields.description: Why the bytes were not stored - a blocked content type, or a file over the size ceiling.
fields.label: Skip Reason

fields.description: The private File row holding the bytes. Empty for a Drive Link, whose bytes stay in Drive under Drive's own ACL.
fields.label: File

fields.description: Google Attachment.contentName - the original filename as the sender saw it, never a path.
fields.label: File Name

fields.description: spaces/{space}/messages/{message}/attachments/{attachment}. Unique so that a replayed inbound event ingests the same attachment at most once - structural dedupe, not procedural. Empty until ingest; Frappe coerces empty to NULL on a unique DocField, so unrelayed rows do not collide.
fields.label: Google Attachment Name

fields.description: attachmentDataRef.resourceName - the only legitimate download handle. Never store or follow downloadUri or thumbnailUri: Google documents both as browser-session URLs and says twice that Chat apps should not use them.
fields.label: Attachment Data Ref

fields.description: driveDataRef.driveFileId. Set instead of file for a Drive Link; media.download explicitly cannot fetch Drive files.
fields.label: Drive File ID
